facts.fact: 死者 Deirdre 的尸体在她到庭院前已被运走，石凳一带拉起黄黑相间的警戒带
facts.anchor: Deirdre Gregory’s body had been taken away already

facts.fact: Adams 说鉴证人员已经来过又走了，还夸他们超级高效
facts.anchor: CSIs have already come and gone

facts.fact: Adams 挑喷泉西侧还没晒到太阳的边沿坐下，让叙述者坐她旁边
facts.anchor: The rim of the fountain was just wide enough to hold us

facts.fact: Adams 说自己的女儿 Caroline 是叙述者写的书的读者
facts.anchor: My daughter is a fan of yours

facts.fact: Adams 说自己目前有三个孩子，拍肚子示意还有一个在路上
facts.anchor: At the moment I have three

facts.fact: Adams 提议让叙述者做她没有正式名分的助手，替她盯着案子
facts.anchor: I want you to be my assistant

facts.fact: Adams 说多数案子在最初四十八小时内破掉，之后就会冷掉
facts.anchor: the majority of cases are solved in the first forty-eight hours

facts.fact: Adams 说自己是警局里唯一的女性，男同事不太愿意听她指挥
facts.anchor: as the only woman on the force

facts.fact: 叙述者数出 Deirdre 是她亲眼见过的第七具尸体，这也是第一次有官方的人请她参与办案
facts.anchor: Deirdre Gregory’s corpse was the seventh dead body
